description: Two jobs. (1) DIAGNOSTIC hook-probe with UI-VISIBLE tracers: the 2026-08-26 exports proved SubagentStop with the scoped matcher left zero trace while PreToolUse:Agent dispatched fine, so hook-probe.ps1 is wired UNCONDITIONALLY ('*') to SubagentStart, SubagentStop, and PostToolUse:Agent. Each dispatch appends to $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/hook-probe.log and queues a tracer line; the MessageDisplay entry drains the queue and prepends a [[punch-hooks]] banner to the next rendered assistant message via displayContent -- hook-lab channel (b), display-only per docs/hooks-ref.md: the model and the transcript never see it. ONE visibility channel per test run, deliberately: no systemMessage (field-proven not rendered in Cowork), no additionalContext (model would see it). Readout: banner shows SubagentStart/Stop => events dispatch (log has the agent_type the scoped matcher must equal); banner shows only PostToolUse:Agent => host skips Subagent* events, echo moves to PostToolUse:Agent; no banner at all but log has lines => displayContent not honored in Cowork, try the next channel; log empty too => hooks not dispatching, compare PreToolUse traces. (2) Final-message echo: show-subagent-final.ps1 stays on the scoped matcher as the differential probe. PURE POWERSHELL host commands -- no python, no sh: Cowork runs hooks on the Windows host. Disable echo with EPLUS_NO_SUBAGENT_ECHO=1.
